identity: V2 limited-compute recovery pilot, fixed before any random samples
levels_interpretation: request support z=level*||direction||_1; successful correction Euclidean norm is at least level before action cap
direction_proposal: current best finite-grid exact-onset likelihood candidate H*b, scaled and rounded to six decimal components; all continuous candidates still checked by certificate
between_queries: exact rational halfspace transport, worst injection over [0,.25]; nonpositive support or numerical uncertainty => zero
point_estimator_between_queries: propagate chosen exact-onset response with its selected constant b, no certification guarantee
runtime_identity: maintenance, scoring, direction selection, certificate and propagation timed separately; reported total includes all
phase: fresh full-period independent phase relative to actual predicted measurement center
recovery_feedback: unchanged monitor; corrections affect output only
small_sample_limit: feasibility pilot; no reliable 0.1% failure-rate measurement, no publication-scale power claim
